methods: Native mouse hover, click and release through browser-act; keyboard Tab, Enter and real popover toggles.
DOM interaction sequences, computed styles, animation timing, geometry, pointer hit testing, immediate state and interrupted animation checks.
Responsive same-origin iframes; the coarse pointer branch selected before module initialization for synthetic touch PointerEvent sequences. No physical phone or Safari run.
Press cascade probes temporarily disable the transition on pointerdown to inspect its target scale; hover and release use the production transitions.
Clipboard success and rejection are stubbed in isolated documents to test copy animations and toasts without changing the system clipboard.
Desktop preferences and 390 px contents sheet screenshots visually inspected.
